explanation: i-j-k reads B[k,j] down a column: consecutive k are M*8 bytes apart, so every inner-loop iteration touches a new cache line and only 8 of 64 bytes are used. i-k-j hoists A[i,k] and streams rows of B and C with stride 1, so each 64-byte line serves 8 doubles, the hardware prefetcher is effective and the loop vectorizes.
